description: The very first READ at :93 reports '30' - a permanent I/O error - so the third arm at :100 moves 12 into APPL-RESULT, 88 APPL-AOK is false at :104, 88 APPL-EOF is false at :107, and :110-113 run: DISPLAY 'ERROR READING XREFFILE', 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then the abend. Four lines and RETURN-CODE 12, with no record line at all: the failing READ does not reach the :96 display and the abend never reaches :78, so a failed read contributes ZERO lines rather than one. The three seeded rows prove it - a translation that displayed the record area on the failing arm would emit them.
